# docs-ai-reverse — full LLM context

## One-line summary

docs-ai-reverse is a local OpenAI-compatible HTTP gateway built on CLIProxyAPI/v7. It registers four Docs AI providers and translates OpenAI client traffic into each upstream protocol.

## What it is / is not

- Is: a reverse adapter / gateway for Docs AI chat assistants.
- Is not: an official Anthropic/Stripe/ReadMe/Mintlify product, a hosted SaaS, or a general LLM proxy for arbitrary OpenAI models.

## Runtime

- Entry: `main.go` (`go run . config.yaml`)
- Default listen: `127.0.0.1:8317`
- Config example: `config.example.yaml` (copy to `config.yaml`; real keys must stay local)
- Auth dir: `./auths` (runtime_only)
- Global outbound proxy: `proxy-url` (`socks5://`, `http://`, `https://`, or `direct`/`none`)
- Probe tool: `cmd/probe` for Mintlify connectivity diagnostics

## Provider matrix

| Model ID        | Provider type | Upstream                         | Streaming notes                                      |
|-----------------|---------------|----------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| claude-docs     | mintlify      | leaves.mintlify.com              | Custom `type:value` line protocol → gateway SSE      |
| anthropic-docs  | inkeep        | api.inkeep.com                   | Native OpenAI-like SSE                               |
| stripe-docs     | stripe        | ai.stripe.com                    | Create thread + poll (~500ms, up to ~60s)            |
| readme-docs     | readme        | docs.readme.com/chatgpt/ask      | Non-stream Markdown wrapped as 3 chunks              |

## Important constraints

- Mintlify may return 418 (VPN/datacenter), 419 (token expiry), 420 (Cloudflare bot), 402 (quota/payment).
- Mintlify tools use prompt-tool XML (`<available_tools>` / `<tool_call>`), parsed at end of response.
- Token counts are local `tiktoken-go` / `o200k_base` estimates; claimed context length is 200k.
- `api-keys` only guard the gateway; they do not select/enable individual providers.
- Skipped / not wired: vercel, fern, gitbook, better-auth, generic mintlify/inkeep auto-detect.

## Key source paths

- `main.go` — startup, auth registration, model catalog
- `internal/provider/` — executors, translator, tokens, proxy
- `internal/mintlify/` — TLS fingerprint client + stream parser
- `internal/inkeep/` — Inkeep HTTP client
- `internal/stripeai/` — Stripe AI client
- `internal/readme/` — ReadMe Ask AI client
